Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending February 12, 1925.
------------------------------------------------------------

The agitation started by the Kuomintang and others
in favour of disbanding soldiers seems to be steadily
becoming more popular and is now receiving considerable
support in commercial circles. In consequence of reports
current during the week that local leaders of the movement
had planned to bring about a general stoppage of work for
a day in order to focus public attention on their campaign,
the Shanghai Military Governor on February 10 felt it
necessary to interview a delegation of representative traders
and urge them to desist from this cause. Further strength
was added to this campaign last week by the formation of
an organization called The Cantonese Self-Determination
Society(粵人自决會), which, in addition to advocating that
Canton be governed by Cantonese, supports the demand for
the disbandment of soldiers. There were about five hundred
people present at the inaugural meeting of this society
which was held on February 10. Other movements which
appear to be fostered to some extent by the Kuomintang and
which are attracting attention include : opposition to the
plans of the Municipal Council for the construction of an
extension to Great Western Road ; condemnation of the Japanese
Government for expelling Chinese workers from Japan ; a
demand that Port Arthur and Dairen be restored to China,
and an agitation arising out of the shooting of strikers
at Hankow. Considerable movement prevails among Dr. Sun
Yat Sen's follows at present. A number of these who have
left for the South are said to include : Hsu Shao Tang
(徐紹楨) alias Zee Koo Ching(徐固卿), Dr. Sun's Chief
aide-de-camp; Wang Tsing Wei(汪精衛), secretary to Dr. Sun,

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending February 5, 1923.
------------------------------------------------------------

Local prominent Kuomintangs are said to be busy at
present endeavouring to compose the differences of the various
military factions in Canton, and are said to entertain hopes of
effecting a solution of the trouble which will enable Dr. Sun
to resume office as Southern President in the near future.
It is also reported that the Soviet Authorities are anxious
to bring about an agreement between General Wu Pei Fu and
Dr. Sun Yat Sen as the best means of furthering their aims
in China. In accordance with this policy, Joffe before
leaving Shanghai, enjoined upon his military assistant Geeker
to interview General Wu Pei Fu and promise him Bolshevik
support against Chang Tso Lin provided Wu agrees to come to an
understanding with Dr. Sun and grant him the latter a voice in
the direction of government affairs. The Bolsheviks are said
to believe that Dr. Sun is not only the most popular politician
in China, but a person whose views on political and economic
matters correspond closely with their own.

Local Kuomintangs are still continuing their efforts
to secure control over Shanghai societies. With this object,
they recently started an organization called The National
Salvation Association with which all local societies were
invited to become affiliated. Failing to get support for this
project, they have now formed an organization called The Racial
Self-Determination Association (民族自决会) whose aims are
almost similar. This society also seems destined to fail for
its first meeting broke up without transacting any business in
consequence of opposition of the attendees to a cabal
nominated by the Kuomintang to act as a committee.

孙中山博士活动概要
截至1923年2月5日的一周。
---

据称，当地著名的国民党人目前正忙于调和广州各军事派系之间的分歧，并有望解决争端，使孙博士在不久的将来恢复南方总统职务。另有报道称，苏维埃当局急于促成吴佩孚将军与孙中山博士达成协议，视其为在中国推进其目标的最佳手段。根据这一政策，越飞在离开上海前，嘱咐其军事助手盖克尔（Geeker）去会晤吴佩孚将军，并承诺如果吴同意与孙博士达成谅解并在政府事务管理中给予后者发言权，布尔什维克将支持吴对抗张作霖。据说布尔什维克认为，孙博士不仅是中国最受欢迎的政治家，而且其在政治和经济问题上的观点与他们自己的观点非常吻合。

当地国民党人仍在继续努力控制上海的各个社团。为此，他们最近成立了一个名为“救国协会”的组织，并邀请所有本地社团加入。由于未能获得对该项目的支持，他们现在又成立了一个名为“民族自决会”的组织，其目标几乎相同。该协会似乎也注定要失败，因为其第一次会议因与会者反对由国民党提名的一个小集团担任委员会而未处理任何事务便解散了。

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending January 29, 1923.
----------

Dr. Sun Yat Sen and twenty one of his followers had planned to proceed to Canton via Hongkong by the "Taiyo Maru" on January 27, but cancelled their passages a few hours before the departure of the boat in consequence of the receipt of a telegram from the South containing news of the overthrow of Dr. Sun's lieutenant General Wei Pong Ping (魏邦平). A Jew named M. A. Cohen who had booked a berth on the same boat also failed to leave. Cohen has been in Shanghai since December 12, 1922, and has visited Dr. Sun a number of times. He appears to be a Jew of Russian origin, but speaks English with an American accent and fairly well.

There is now good reason to believe that Dr. Sun had an interview with Mr. A. Joffe, Envoy to China of the Russian Soviet Republic on January 20, and it is known for sure that they had two further meetings since the last report was submitted, one in Dr. Sun's home, 29 Rue Moliere on January 22 and another in the Great Eastern Hotel on January 25. As a result of these meetings Dr. Sun and Joffe reached an agreement which, according to a "White" Russian informer, whose information in some other respects has been tested and found to be substantially accurate, contains provisions under which the Soviet Government will give moral and financial support to Dr. Sun Yat Sen who, in return, undertakes to recognize and form an alliance with Soviet Russia as soon as his party secures control of the Government of China. Questions of a military nature also appear to have been discussed by the Soviet Envoy and Kuomintang Chief for the former's military adviser, General Gaecker was hastily summoned to give some expert advice. THE SHANGHAI TIMES. SATURDAY, JANUARY 27, 1923.

M. A. JOFFE'S CONVERSATIONS
WITH DR. SUN YAT-SEN

AUTHORIZED STATEMENT ISSUED

Identity Of Views On Vital Issues;
No Imperialism In Mongolia

Dr. Sun Yat-sen and Mr. A. A.
Joffe, Russian Envoy Extraordin-
ary and Plenipotentiary to China,
have authorized the publication
of the following statement:—
During his stay in Shanghai,
Mr. Joffe has had several conver-
sations with Dr. Sun Yat-sen,
which have revealed the identity
of their views on matters relating
to Chinese-Russian relations,
more especially on the following
points:—
The Communistic Order
(1).—Dr. Sun Yat-sen holds
that the Communistic order or
even the Soviet system cannot
actually be introduced into China,
because there do not exist here
the conditions for the successful
establishment of either Com-
munism or Sovietism. This view
is entirely shared by Mr. Joffe,
who is further of opinion that
China's paramount and most
pressing problem is to achieve
national unification and attain
full national independence; and
regarding this great task, he was
assured Dr. Sun Yat-sen that
China has the warmest sympathy
of the Russian people and can
count on the support of Russia.
Re-Affirmation Of Principles
(2).—In order to clarify the
situation, Dr. Sun Yat-sen has re-
quested Mr. Joffe for a re-affirma-
tion of the principles defined in
the Russian Note to the Chinese
Government, dated September 27,
1920. Mr. Joffe has accordingly
re-affirmed those principles and
categorically declared to Dr. Sun
Yat-sen that the Russian Govern-
ment is ready and willing to enter
into negotiations with China on
the basis of the renunciation by
Russia of all the treaties and
exactions which the Tsarist Gov-
ernment imposed on China, including the
treaty or treaties and agreements
relating to the Chinese Eastern
Railway (the management of
which being the subject of a
specific reference in article VII
of the said Note).
(3).—Recognizing that the
Chinese Eastern Railway ques-
tion in its entirety can be satis-
factorily settled only at a com-
petent Russo-Chinese Conference,
Dr. Sun Yat-sen is of opinion
that the realities of the situation
point to the desirability of a
modus vivendi in the matter of
the present management of the
Railway. And he agrees with
Mr. Joffe that the existing Rail-
way management should be tem-
porarily re-organized by agree-
ment between the Chinese and
the Russian Governments without
prejudice, however, to the true
rights and special interests of
either party. At the same time
Dr. Sun Yat-sen considers that
General Chang Tso-lin should be
consulted on the point.
A Categorical Declaration
(4).—Mr. Joffe has categorically
declared to Dr. Sun Yat-sen (who
has fully satisfied himself as to
this) that it is not and has never
been the intention or purpose of
the present Russian Government
to pursue an imperialistic policy
in Outer Mongolia or to cause it
to secede from China. Dr. Sun
Yat-sen therefore does not view
an immediate evacuation of Rus-
sian troops from Outer Mongolia
as either imperative or in the real
interest of China. He sees no ob-
jection to the retention of the
present garrison as a means to
prevent any aggressive action being
followed by the White Guards or in-
trigues and plots directed by
White Guards against Russia,
and this owing to the actual situa-
tion then prevailing there exists.

Shanghai, Jan. 26, 1923.

M. A. 越飞与孙中山博士的会谈

发布授权声明

在重要问题上的观点一致；
蒙古不存在帝国主义

孙中山博士与俄罗斯驻华特命全权公使 A. A. 越飞先生授权发表如下声明：—

越飞先生在上海逗留期间，与孙中山博士进行了数次会谈，表明双方在中俄关系相关事项上观点一致，特别是在以下几点：—

共产主义秩序
(1).—孙中山博士认为，共产主义秩序甚至苏维埃制度实际上无法引入中国，因为这里不具备成功建立共产主义或苏维埃主义的条件。越飞先生完全赞同这一观点，他进一步认为，中国最重要且最紧迫的问题是实现国家统一并获得完全的国家独立；关于这项伟大任务，他向孙中山博士保证，中国人民对中国怀有最热烈的同情，中国可以指望俄罗斯的支持。

重申原则
(2).—为了澄清局势，孙中山博士请求越飞先生重申1920年9月27日俄罗斯致中国政府照会中所确定的原则。越飞先生据此重申了这些原则，并向孙中山博士明确声明，俄罗斯政府愿意并准备在俄罗斯放弃沙皇政府强加给中国的所有条约和勒索的基础上与中国进行谈判，包括涉及中东铁路（该铁路的管理在上述照会第七条中有专门提及）的条约或协定。
(3).—认识到中东铁路整个问题只有在适当的中俄会议上才能得到满意解决，孙中山博士认为，现实情况表明，就铁路目前的管理达成一种临时安排是可取的。他同意越飞先生的看法，即现有的铁路管理应由中俄两国政府通过协议暂时重组，但这不得损害任何一方的真正权利和特殊利益。同时，孙中山博士认为在此问题上应征求张作霖将军的意见。

一项明确声明
(4).—越飞先生向孙中山博士明确声明（孙博士对此已充分确信），现任俄罗斯政府无意也从未打算在外蒙古推行帝国主义政策或促使外蒙古从中国分离。因此，孙中山博士并不认为俄罗斯军队立即撤出外蒙古是强制性的或符合中国的真正利益。他认为保留现有驻军以防止白卫军采取任何侵略行动或进行针对俄罗斯的阴谋诡计并无不妥，这是由于当时当地存在的实际局势所致。

上海，1923年1月26日。

CUTTING FROM EVENING NEWS, THE KUOMINTANG ORGAN IN ENGLISH
DATED JANUARY 27, 1923.

RUSSIA AND CHINA

BY EUGENE CHEN

Russia shares with China some strain of the blood of High Asia. Scratch the Muscovite, it is said, you find the Tartar. Is it this call of the blood that has turned the face of Russia towards China? But I leave this intriguing thought and direct attention to the post-war policy of the Anglo-Latin conquerors in the Great War. For it is M. Clemenceau's cordon sanitaire and its Caesarean implications that one must assign the presence of the Russian at Angora, at Teheran, at Cabul in sight of the road to India, and at Peking. I may have had to add—Tokio. Thither, it seems, the strange diplomacy of the Mandarin capital was sending, in disgust, the revolutionary heir of Old Russia. But the possibility of that orientation has now disappeared through the intervention of Dr. Sun Yat-sen. This is one meaning of the conversations recorded in the communique printed in THE EVENING NEWS today.

There are other meanings. The menacing movement of secession which was tearing the great limb of Outer Mongolia from the body of China is arrested. And the same may be said of the parallel development in connexion with the Chinese Eastern Railway which appeared to threaten a complication that could only issue in a war of three nations in Northern Manchuria.

There is a suggestion that the ultimate outcome of the policy underlying the conversations between Dr. Sun Yat-sen and M. Joffe depends on the attitude of the Great Powers towards Russia and towards the Chinese leader. That outcome might be a fruitful co-operation between Russia and China, making available their material and cultural resources for the use and service of humanity; or, continued hostility to Russia and what appears like hostility to Dr. Sun Yat-sen in certain quarters might forge an iron alliance between Russia and China directed to other ends. There is a note of boldness here. Or do you say it has the accent of audacity? Perhaps; but all great prophecies are audacities.

Be this as it may, it is clear that the conversations necessarily alter the international rating of Dr. Sun. He emerges definitely as a world force. The support of Russia seems to be pledged to him. What does this mean? In spite of the economic blockade, Russia remains and is actually a Great Power; and potentially she is perhaps the greatest Power of tomorrow. She may be disarrayed. But that is a passing phase, inseparable from the turmoils of war and the deep stirrings of a mighty change in the life of nations. She must soon re-enter the economic life of the world through recognition, long over-due. And at once her transport system will be set in order and the blood will re-flow in rich streams through her body. Then Russia will re-emerge in her strength, powerful and decisive in the affairs of nations. And this resurgent Russia will be the friend and ally of Sun Yat-sen.

俄罗斯与中国

作者：陈友仁

俄罗斯与中国共享一些高亚细亚的血统。据说，刮开莫斯科人的皮肤，你会发现鞑靼人。正是这种血缘的呼唤使俄罗斯面向中国吗？但我暂且放下这个引人深思的想法，将注意力转向第一次大战后盎格鲁-拉丁征服者的政策。因为必须将俄罗斯人在安哥拉、德黑兰、喀布尔（印度道路视线范围内）以及北京的出现，归因于克莱蒙梭先生的防疫封锁线及其凯撒式的含义。我或许还得加上——东京。似乎 Mandarin 首都（指北京）的奇特外交正厌恶地将旧俄罗斯的革命继承人送往那里。但随着孙中山博士的介入，这种导向的可能性现已消失。这就是今天刊登在《晚间新闻》上的公报中所记录的会谈的含义之一。

还有其他含义。企图将外蒙古这一巨大肢体从中国躯体上撕裂出去的分离主义威胁运动已被制止。同样，与中东铁路相关的平行发展也可作如是观，该发展似乎威胁要引发一场只能导致北满三国战争的复杂局面。

有一种暗示表明，孙中山博士与越飞先生会谈背后政策的最终结果，取决于列强对俄罗斯及对中国领导人的态度。其结果可能是俄中之间富有成效的合作，将其物质和文化资源用于人类的福祉和服务；或者，对俄罗斯的持续敌意以及在某些方面看似对孙中山博士的敌意，可能会促成俄中结成以其他目的为导向的铁盟。这里有一种大胆的基调。或者说它具有鲁莽的口吻？也许吧；但所有伟大的预言都是鲁莽的。

无论如何，很明显，这些会谈必然改变孙中山博士的国际地位。他明确地作为一种世界力量出现。俄罗斯的支持似乎已向他承诺。这意味着什么？尽管受到经济封锁，俄罗斯仍然存在，并且实际上是一个大国；而且从潜力上看，她也许是明天最伟大的强国。她可能处于混乱之中。但这只是一个短暂的阶段，与战争的动荡以及国家生活中巨大变革的深层激荡密不可分。她必须通过迟来的承认，尽快重新进入世界经济生活。一旦如此，她的运输系统将得到整顿，血液将通过她的身体重新丰富地流动。届时，俄罗斯将以强大的姿态重新崛起，在国际事务中发挥强大而决定性的作用。而这个复兴的俄罗斯将成为孙中山的朋友和盟友。

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending January 8, 1923.
--------------------------------------

Local Kuomintangs are reported to be jubilant over the
victories of their partisans at Wuchow on the Kwangtung-Kwangsi
border, and in an interview with the North China Daily News
Dr. Sun Yat Sen has boasted that his troops will enter Canton in
about two weeks. In the same interview Dr. Sun stated that
peace offers made to him by General Wu Pei Fu had come to nothing,
but that he is still negotiating with General Tsao Kun (曹錕).
On January 1, the Kuomintang issued a manifesto containing the
following statement of its policy :-

1- To promote racial regeneration by (a) enforcing universal
education, (b) revision of international treaties so as to
secure for China all her former freedom and place the nation on
the same level as other foreign countries.

2- To reform the system of election by (a) establishing universal
franchise and abolishing class privileges, (b) allowing
freedom of the press, freedom of speech and freedom to assemble.

3- To make plans for an equal distribution of wealth and the
solution of all difficult economic problems,
(a) To place a limit on the area of land which each individual
citizen is entitled to hold, and impose taxes in accordance
with equity,
(b) The nationalization of all certain industries such as
railways, mines, forests and navigation, and the formulation
of a scheme under which the labourers will have a voice in
their control.
(c) To get correct statistics of agricultural produce, and
to distribute the stable food equally among the people,
(d) To reform the monetary system,
(e) To institute a statute for the protection of labourers
and improvement of their working conditions,
(f) To allow sex equality,
(g) To improve the condition and raise the status of peasant
farmers.

据报，当地国民党员对其党羽在广东-广西边境梧州取得的胜利感到欢欣鼓舞，孙中山博士在接受《字林西报》采访时夸口称，他的部队将在约两周内进入广州。在同一次采访中，孙博士表示，吴佩孚将军向他提出的和平建议已无果而终，但他仍在与曹锟（Tsao Kun）将军进行谈判。1月1日，国民党发布了一份宣言，其中包含以下政策声明：

1- 通过以下方式促进民族复兴：(a) 实行普及教育，(b) 修订国际条约，以确保中国恢复以往所有的自由，并使国家处于与其他外国同等的地位。

2- 改革选举制度：(a) 建立普选制并废除阶级特权，(b) 允许新闻自由、言论自由和集会自由。

3- 制定财富平均分配计划并解决所有棘手的经济问题：
(a) 限制每个公民有权持有的土地面积，并按公平原则征税，
(b) 将铁路、矿山、森林和航运等特定行业国有化，并制定方案使工人在管理中有发言权。
(c) 获取准确的农产品统计数据，并在民众中平均分配主食，
(d) 改革货币制度，
(e) 颁布保护工人及改善其工作条件的法规，
(f) 允许男女平等，
(g) 改善农民处境并提高其地位。

It is stated in well informed circles that Dr. Sun Yat Sen
is at present well supplied with funds with which he has purchased
the allegiance of several generals at Wuchow and a controlling
interest in some foreign and Chinese newspapers in Shanghai.
It is also reported that persons acting on his behalf attempted
to purchase a supply of guns, small arms and ammunition at
a figure variously estimated above $1,000,000.00 from Admiral
Stark, who commands a fleet of Russian ships, which escaped from
Vladivostok after the capture of that city by the Reds, and is
now anchored off Woosung.

Apart from the embarrassments caused by Dr. Sun Yat Sen's
activities, the Central Government is now confronted with fresh
difficulties in consequence of action taken by the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce which during the week in a lengthy telegram
to Parliament condemning the financial authorities in Peking
for pledging the nation's resources for self-aggrandisement,
demands the publication of full details of all loans contracted
since China became a Republic. This telegram was drafted by
the Committee on disarmament, finance and the constitution
recently organized by the Chinese Chambers' Commerce.

Mr. George Hsu Chion (徐謙) has returned to Shanghai, and is
again living at No. 1298 Avenue Edward VII where a school for
suffragettes has been opened by his wife and the publication of a
newspaper called the Christian Uplift has been established.
Hsu Chion is at present busy promoting an organization called
the National Salvation Association, which aims at co-ordinating
the efforts of all patriotic societies in Shanghai. He is
assisted in this work by a Roman Catholic priest named Ho Siang
Pah (馬相伯) who is an octogenarian.

Further information now received shows that, in addition to
those already named, the following persons visited Dr. Sun Yat Sen's
house during the past two weeks:- Song Fah Hsu (孫發緒), ex-
civil governor of Anhui, Chang Chi (張繼), alias Tsang Poo Kio
(張溥泉), a secretary of Dr. Sun, Tai Li Ling (禮林).

除了孙中山博士的活动造成的困境外，中央政府现在又面临新的困难，这是由于中华总商会采取的行动所致。该商会在本周向国会发出的一份长篇电报中，谴责北京财政当局以国家资源为私利作抵押，并要求公布自中国成为共和国以来所签订的所有贷款的详细细节。这份电报是由中华总商会最近组织的裁军、财政和宪法委员会起草的。

徐谦（George Hsu Chion）先生已返回上海，再次居住在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）1298号，他的妻子在那里开设了一所妇女参政学校，并创办了一份名为《Christian Uplift》的报纸。徐谦目前正忙于推动一个名为“救国协会”的组织，该组织旨在协调上海所有爱国团体的努力。一位名叫马相伯（Ho Siang Pah）的罗马天主教神父协助他进行这项工作，这位神父已是八旬老人。

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending January 1, 1923.

The Central Government has averted the crisis created
through the opposition of provincial officials to the
increased postal rates by reverting to the old tariff, and
it is reported that the news of its surrender has been
received with great satisfaction by local Kuomintangs who
consider that the loss of revenue and prestige, which
reversion to the old rates entails for the Central Government
is sure to hasten the disruption.

Although the arrival and departure from and to outports
and places of the interior of delegates of Dr. Sun Yat Sen
still continues, there seems to have been a lull in Kuomintang
activities during the holidays. Ten members of the party
including Chang Chiu Bah(张秋白), an ex-M.P., Chang Chi
(张继), a secretary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen, and Chu Tseng
(朱征), who recently resigned from a similar position, attended
a tiffin party at No. 7 Albany Road on December 27, but
the timely intervention of the police who had been apprised
before of the intention to hold the function compelled the
diners to abandon plans they had made to discuss matters
of a political nature. Chang Chi(张继) who recently
returned from the North, is now living in No. 44 Route
Vallon.

A memorial service in honour of a Kuomintang named
Chen Su Fan(陳樹藩), who should not be confounded with
the person of the same name who was once Civil Governor of
Shense, was held in the Pau Pung Dong(報本堂) temple,
316 Tientsin Road between 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. December 27,
during which time the place was visited by Yang Yu Kai
(楊庶堪), who represented Dr. Sun Yat Sen, Sung Hsing Ti
(宋漢伊), ex-Minister of the Interior, Sun Fo(孫科).

截至1923年1月1日当周孙中山博士活动摘要

中央政府通过将邮资费率恢复至旧标准，避免了因省级官员反对提高邮资而引发的危机。据报，当地国民党员对这一让步的消息感到非常满意，他们认为恢复旧费率导致中央政府收入和声望的损失，肯定会加速其瓦解。

尽管孙中山博士的代表往返于各通商口岸和内地的活动仍在继续，但在假期期间，国民党的活动似乎出现了短暂的平静。12月27日，包括前国会议员张秋白（Chang Chiu Bah）、孙中山博士秘书张继（Chang Chi）以及最近辞去类似职务的朱征（Chu Tseng）在内的十名党员，在阿尔巴尼路（Albany Road）7号参加了一次午餐会，但由于警方事先获悉举行该活动的意图并及时干预，迫使用餐者放弃了讨论政治性质事务的计划。最近从北方回来的张继（Chang Chi）现在住在华伦路（Route Vallon）44号。

12月27日下午2时至5时，在天津路316号的报本堂（Pau Pung Dong）寺庙举行了一场追悼一名名为陈树藩（Chen Su Fan）的国民党员的仪式，此人不应与曾任陕西省长的同名人士混淆。在此期间，代表孙中山博士的杨庶堪（Yang Yu Kai）、前内务总长宋汉伊（Sung Hsing Ti，即宋教仁或相关人物，原文如此）以及孙科（Sun Fo）到访了该地。

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending December 25, 1922.
------------------------------------------------------------

The past week has been marked by considerable
activity in Kuomintang circles. A further batch of
recruits was dispatched to Fokien by the s.s. "Ningshing"
on December 19. These men were recruited by one Yang Hu
(楊虎) alias Yang Siau Tien (楊嘯天) who accompanied them
to their destination. The wife of Yang Hu, who is an
old member of the Kuomintang party, is still residing at
No. 282 Rue Kraetzer. Other notable Kuomintangs who left
during the week are Loo Sz Tien (盧師諦) and Chang Chi
(張繼). Loo who once held a high military command in
Szechuen, is said to have gone to Fokien. He resided up
to the time of his departure at No. 38 Pau Keng Lee (寶慶里),
Avenue Joffre. Chang Chi who is a secretary to Dr. Sun
Yat Sen, is reported to have proceeded to Paotingfu. While
here he made No. 30 Rue Marcel Tillot his headquarters.
Tsang Yuh Bang (張翼鵬), who is reported to have been in
Shanghai for some time on a mission from Chao Heng Tih
(趙恆惕), Tuchun of Hunan, to Dr. Sun Yat Sen, returned
to that province on December 24. While in Shanghai Tsang
lived with one of the oldest members of the Kuomintang
party named Yui Yue Zung (于右任) at No. 130 Rue de
Lagrene. Towards the end of the week, a report was current
that serious differences had arisen among local Kuomintangs
and it was alleged Chu Tseng (居正) alias Chu Kyak Sung
(居覺生) and other prominent men had submitted their
resignations as a protest against their senior Ho Hai Ming
(胡漢民) who is accused of being harsh and overbearing.
Ho lives at No. 3 Nan Ming Tuh Lee (南明德里), Route
Vallon.

A member of the Kuomintang party is making
arrangements to open a news agency at No. 474 Woo Foh Lee

过去一周，国民党圈内活动相当活跃。12月19日，另一批新兵由“宁兴”轮（s.s. "Ningshing"） dispatched 至福建。这些人由杨虎（Yang Hu），别名杨啸天（Yang Siau Tien）招募，并陪同他们前往目的地。杨虎的妻子是国民党的老党员，仍居住在克雷策路（Rue Kraetzer）282号。本周离开的其他著名国民党员包括卢师谛（Loo Sz Tien）和张继（Chang Chi）。卢师谛曾在四川担任高级军事指挥职务，据说已前往福建。他在离开前一直居住在霞飞路宝庆里（Pau Keng Lee）38号。据报，身为孙中山博士秘书的张继已前往保定府。他在上海期间以马塞尔·蒂洛路（Rue Marcel Tillot）30号为总部。张翼鹏（Tsang Yuh Bang，音译）据报因湖南督军赵恒惕（Chao Heng Tih）派遣的使命在上海停留了一段时间，以会见孙中山博士，他于12月24日返回该省。在上海期间，张翼鹏与国民党最老资格的成员之一于右任（Yui Yue Zung）同住，地址为拉格纳路（Rue de Lagrene）130号。临近周末，有传言称当地国民党员之间出现了严重分歧，据称居正（Chu Tseng），别名居觉生（Chu Kyak Sung）及其他知名人士已提交辞呈，以抗议他们的上级胡汉民（Ho Hai Ming，即胡汉民），后者被指责严厉且专横。胡汉民住在华伦路（Route Vallon）南明德里（Nan Ming Tuh Lee）3号。

一名国民党员正在安排于爱多亚路法租界王福里（Woo Foh Lee）

A resolution in favour of dispatching a letter
to the Civil Governor of Anhui demanding that severe
measures be taken against Magistrate Wong Hau Sze (王浩九)
of Sze Shien (四縣) district (Anhui) was passed unanimously
at a meeting of representatives of various Anhui organiza-
tions held in 506 Foh Ziang Lee (福祥里), Foochow Road,

who recently arrived from Anhui, had read a report regarding
the execution of a student named Tsu Sz Tsung (周士俊)

present at the meeting which was presided over by Wong Loong
Ding (王龍庭), an ex-M.P. who is a prominent member of
the Anhui Soldiers' Disbandment Association. The proceedings
terminated at 5 p.m.
A rather serious situation, which the Kuomintangs
will no doubt endeavour to exploit to their advantage,
has arisen in Shanghai in consequence of the refusal of several
officials including the Governors of Chekiang and Kiangsu,
to obey the orders for the increase of postal and telegraph
rates which seem to be generally unpopular.

由于包括浙江和江苏省长在内的几名官员拒绝执行普遍不受欢迎的提高邮政和电报费率的命令，上海出现了一种相当严峻的局势，国民党员无疑会试图利用这一局势为自己谋利。

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending Dec. 19, 1922.
--------
Shanghai Koumingtang societies and newspapers continue to demand the dismissal of General Ma Lien Yah of Anhui, who is now accused of cruelly ill treating students, and denounce Generals Chang Fong Kui (張福來) and Wu Pei Foo (吳佩孚) for allowing bandits to create a reign of terror in Honan. Other Government officials are similarly censured for permitting bandit activities in Tsingtau which, the critics assert is likely to lead to foreign intervention in Chinese domestic affairs. While continuing friendly to the Koumingtang, the local Bolshevik organ is criticising that party for holding aloof from labour, and in reports published during the week giving news about a movement for the establishment of a Central labour union in Canton accuse Chen Chuan Ming (陳炯明) of being a reactionary and a friend of capitalism. Contradictory reports appear in the Press about the relations between the Koumingtang and General Lu Ying Ziang (盧永祥). In one paper it is alleged that two notorious Koumingtang named Chulh Ching (居正) and Wong Da Wei (黃大偉) recently visited Hangchow and discussed measures for the joint defence of Fukien and Chekiang and it is also stated that Little Hsu has been in Hangchow since his alleged return from the South, while another paper claims that General Lu Ying Ziang (盧永祥) of Chekiang and General Ho Fung Ling (何丰林) of Shanghai are likely in the near future to receive special promotion in return for which they will give unconditional allegiance to the Central Government.

Dr. Sun Yat sen's callers during the week included Dr. Alfred Sze (施肇基), Chinese Minister to Washington, and Parley P. Christensen, the Farmer-Labour Party candidate for President of the United States in 1920. The last named,

上海国民党社团和报纸继续要求罢免安徽督军马联甲，此人目前被指控残酷虐待学生，并谴责张福来将军（張福來）和吴佩孚将军（吳佩孚）纵容匪徒在河南制造恐怖统治。其他政府官员也因允许青岛发生匪患而受到类似的谴责，批评人士断言这可能导致外国干涉中国内政。当地布尔什维克机关报在对国民党保持友好的同时，批评该党脱离劳工运动，并在本周发布的关于在广州建立中央工会运动的报道中，指责陈炯明（陳炯明）是反动派和资本主义之友。报刊上出现了关于国民党与卢永祥将军（盧永祥）之间关系的矛盾报道。一家报纸声称，两名著名的国民党人居正（居正）和黄大伟（黃大偉）最近访问了杭州，讨论了福建和浙江联合防御的措施，并称小徐自据称从南方返回后一直待在杭州；而另一家报纸则声称，浙江的卢永祥将军（盧永祥）和上海的何丰林将军（何丰林）可能在不久的将来获得特别晋升，作为交换，他们将向中央政府表示无条件效忠。

本周拜访孙中山博士的客人包括中国驻华盛顿公使施肇基博士（Dr. Alfred Sze），以及1920年美国农民-劳工党总统候选人帕利·P·克里斯滕森（Parley P. Christensen）。后者，

于12月13日前往香港。他曾在12月？日于礼查饭店（Astor House）他的房间内会见了一位名叫黎世良（Li Sz Liang）的世界语学者。黎在北四川路一所学校任教，该校多年来一直被怀疑参与布尔什维克活动。据称是吴佩孚幕僚成员的白坚武（Boh Chi Woo），于12月16日在莫利爱路29号拜访了孙中山博士，并在欧仁·巴德路（Rue Eugene Bard）三益里10号拜访了孙洪伊（Tung Hung Yi）。白与孙博士交谈了一小时，与孙洪伊交谈了半小时。后者曾任内务总长，被认为是国民党中最能干的人之一。

47
Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending Dec. 11, 1922.
------
The difficulties besetting the Central Government in
consequence of differences amongst the supporters and the chaos
created by bandits in several loyal provinces have raised the
spirits of the Kuomintang party who are now more hopeful about
the future plans than they have been for some time. Dr. Sun's
followers are said to be especially pleased with the turn
events which are taking place in Tsingtau and have dispatched a
number of minor leaders to organize their supporters in that
region, so that the brigand bands can be secretly assisted to
make ordered government impossible. The position in Tsingtau
and the Fukien situation are said to have been discussed in detail
at an important conference in Dr. Sun's house on December 8.
The attendance on that occasion comprised Wong Da Wei(黄大伟),
Hu Han Ming(胡漢民), Chang Chi(張繼), Chu Cheng (居正) and
twenty others, and their deliberations lasted from 4.30 p.m.
to 7 p.m. Tan Yen Kai(谭延闿), 489 Avenue Joffre, who formerly
held a high position in Hunan, spent three quarters of an hour
with Dr. Sun on December 5.
A book attacking Chen Chiuin Ming(陳炯明) for revolting
against the Southern Government is now on sale in the Kuomintang
book stores here.
Ten men who claimed to have acted as Dr. Sun Yat Sen's
bodyguard in Canton asked for assistance at his house on
December 8, but were sent away empty handed.
George Hsu Chien(徐謙), ex-Minister of Justice in
the Canton Cabinet, is reported to have left secretly for
the North a few days ago. In the meantime his wife is continuing
her campaign for sex equality in which she is trying to enlist
the support of all female students.

孙中山博士活动摘要
截至1922年12月11日的一周。
------
由于支持者之间的分歧以及几个忠诚省份因匪患造成的混乱，中央政府面临的困难鼓舞了国民党的士气，他们对未来计划的希望比过去一段时间以来更为高涨。据说孙中山的追随者对青岛发生的局势转变特别高兴，并已派遣多名次要领导人到该地区组织支持者，以便秘密协助匪帮，使有序治理成为不可能。据说12月8日在孙中山寓所举行的一次重要会议上，详细讨论了青岛的局势和福建的情况。出席会议的有黄大伟（Wong Da Wei）、胡汉民（Hu Han Ming）、张继（Chang Chi）、居正（Chu Cheng）等二十余人，他们的商议从下午4时30分持续到晚上7时。曾任湖南高官的谭延闿（Tan Yen Kai），住址为霞飞路489号，于12月5日与孙博士交谈了四十五分钟。
一本攻击陈炯明（Chen Chiuin Ming）背叛南方政府的书籍目前正在这里的国民党书店出售。
十名自称曾在广州担任孙中山博士保镖的男子于12月8日到其寓所请求援助，但空手而归。
据报道，广州内阁前司法总长徐谦（George Hsu Chien）已于数日前秘密北上。与此同时，他的妻子继续进行争取性别平等的运动，试图争取所有女学生的支持。

pages.en:
46

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending December 4, 1922.

The exposure of their connection with recruiting for the
armies in Fukien, which showed the insincerity of their demands
for the disbandment of soldiers, does not seem to have in any
way disturbed local Kuomintang agitators who are continuing
their activities as usual. General Wong Da Wei (黃大偉)
arrived here from Fukien in the early part of the week and is
residing at No. 351 Talu Road. He and Chang Chi (張繼) who,
on behalf of Dr. Sun Yat Sen, has visited a number of prominent
men in different parts of the country, had luncheon with the
Doctor on November 30, and local Kuomintangs gave a tiffin
in his honour in the Great Eastern Hotel on Dec. 1. Several
Speeches eulogising General Wong Da Wei for his ability as a
military leader and congratulating him on his recent victories
in Fukien were made during the feast. The function was presided
over by Zee Shao Tseng (徐紹楨), who is Chief Aide-de-Camp
to Dr. Sun Yat Sen, and those present, of whom there were about
ninety, included Ma Chun Wu (馬君武), Chief Secretary to
Dr. Sun Yat Sen, Hu Han Ming (胡漢民), ex-Futuh of Canton,
Sung Hung Yi (孫洪伊), formerly Minister of Interior, Chang
Chi (張繼), a secretary to Dr. Sun, Wu Chao Chu (伍朝樞), son
of the late Dr. Wu Ting Fang, Wong Ching Wei (汪精衛), a
prominent Kuomintang and close friend of Dr. Sun.

It is reliably reported that nine or ten members of the
Kuomintang party, who have been engaged promoting agitations
here against the Central Government during the past year,
have obtained posts in Fukien and will soon leave for that
province. The favoured politicians include Yu Yah Tze
(俞育之), Chairman of the National Organizations' Union of
China, 17 San Yih Lee (三益里), Rue Eugene Bard, Wyi Pei Wei
(嚴伯威), and Dung Ka Tsing (鄧家彥), former member of the
National Diplomatic Federation, which was dissolved on
February 28, 1922.

孙中山博士活动摘要
截至1922年12月4日的一周。

他们与福建军队招募工作的联系被揭露，显示了他们要求遣散士兵的虚伪性，但这似乎并未以任何方式扰乱当地的国民党煽动者，他们照常继续活动。黄大伟将军（General Wong Da Wei）于本周初从福建抵达此地，现居住在大路351号。他和张继（Chang Chi）——后者代表孙中山博士走访了全国各地的许多知名人士——于11月30日与孙博士共进午餐，当地国民党人于12月1日在大东饭店为他举行了午宴。宴会上发表了多篇演讲，赞扬黄大伟将军作为军事领导人的才能，并祝贺他最近在福建取得的胜利。该活动由孙中山博士的首席副官徐绍桢（Zee Shao Tseng）主持，出席者约九十人，包括孙中山博士的秘书长马君武（Ma Chun Wu）、前广东督军胡汉民（Hu Han Ming）、前内务总长孙洪伊（Sung Hung Yi）、孙中山博士的秘书张继（Chang Chi）、已故伍廷芳博士之子伍朝枢（Wu Chao Chu）、著名国民党人且为孙博士密友的汪精卫（Wong Ching Wei）。

有可靠消息报道，过去一年中在此地从事反对中央政府煽动活动的九或十名国民党党员，已在福建获得职位，并将很快前往该省。受青睐的政治家包括：中国全国团体联合会主席俞育之（Yu Yah Tze），住址为欧仁·巴德路三益里17号；严伯威（Wyi Pei Wei）；以及邓家彦（Dung Ka Tsing），后者曾是1922年2月28日解散的全国外交联合会的成员。

Societies in Shanghai consisting of the residents of
different streets and designated Street Unions, which are
to a great extent under the influence of the Kuomintang and
which after a period of marked activity following their formation
in 1919 became comparatively quiet, have recently shown signs
of renewed vigour and are at present conducting a campaign for
the restoration of the Mixed Court to Chinese control, and
their activities in this connection are receiving wide publicity
in the Chinese Press.

Summary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Activities
During Week Ending November 27, 1922.
-----------------------

There is now good reason to believe that, in addition
to his other activities, Dr. Sun Yat Sen has assisted in
supplying the Kuomintang armies in Fukien with recruits,
of whom about two thousand have already been sent from
Shanghai to that province during the past few months.
Evidence of Dr. Sun's complicity in this matter came to
light on November 20 when his representative paid $5.00
each in the French Central Police Station to a squad about
ninety strong of the Chinese soldiers whose disembarkation became
necessary in consequence of their arrest by the French
police. Other revelations regarding the recruiting earlier
in the same day showed that arrangements had been made to
send about six hundred men to Foochow by the s.s. "Hing Fat",
belonging to the Sun Pek S. N. Co. These plans miscarried
through the Shanghai Defence Commissioner, General Ho Feng
Ling, causing the removal of the recruits from the ship by
a party of armed police. General Ho took action at the
request of the President of the Fukien Fellow-Countrymen's
Association, and rumours that he was influenced in his
decision by telegrams from Admiral Sah Cheng Ping seem to
be groundless. A batch of 100 recruits sent to Fukien
subsequent to this incident travelled by the s.s.
"Seikyo Maru" which sailed at 1 p.m. November 22. Further
parties of recruits are expected to proceed to Fukien
in the near future.

Inquiries indicate that the recruiting of men for
the Fukien armies is done in territory outside the juris-
diction of the Municipal Council, and the principal agents
engaged in the work are Wu Ming (吴明) who until

现在有充分理由相信，除了其他活动外，孙中山博士还协助为福建的国民党军队提供新兵，在过去几个月中，已有约两千人从上海被送往该省。孙博士与此事有关的证据于11月20日曝光，当时他的代表在法国中央巡捕房向一队约九十名的中国士兵每人支付了5.00美元，这些士兵因被法国警察逮捕而不得不登陆。当天早些时候关于招募工作的其他披露显示，已安排通过顺北轮船公司（Sun Pek S. N. Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week ending Nov. 20, 1922.
---------
The satisfaction prevailing last week in local Kuoming-
tang circles over events in Fokien has given way to a feeling
of uncertainty in consequence of reports that friction
exists among the new military leaders in that province. Under
the circumstances there is no likelihood that Dr. Sun Yat Sen
will act on advice given by some of his partisans to proceed
to Foochow, but will remain in Shanghai to await develop-
ments, expected next Spring when it is thought that General
Chang Tsong Ling(張宗昌) will make a fresh attempt to obtain
control of the Central Government. It is said that Chang
is training a large army to conquer Wu Pei Foo(吳佩孚) while
his friends of the Kuomintang and other parties are endea-
vouring to weaken Wu's military power through the promotion
of brigandage and labour troubles in his territory. An
emissary of Tuan Chi Jui(段祺瑞) named Ho Chuan Hsun(何傳勳)
is reported to have been a guest on November 16 at a party
given by Dr. Sun Yat Sen, an invitation which was not
accepted by Hsu Shu Tseng(徐樹錚) alias Little Hsu who is
believed to be in Shanghai, although efforts to locate him
have not been successful.
Other Kuomintang activities during the week include
preparations for the holding of a memorial service in honour
of Dr. Wu Ting Fang, and arrangements for opening a school
for suffragettes on December 1 by Mrs. George Mau Hsien
at No. 1898 Avenue Edward VII.
It is reliably reported that Lam Wai Ming, chairman of
the local branch of the Chinese Seamen's Union, for whose
arrest the French Police have held a warrant for some time,
has gone to Nanking, where he will take over the presidency
of the Social Department of the branch of the Chinese Sea-

截至1922年11月20日的一周内
孙中山博士的活动。
---------
上周当地国民党圈子因福建事态而产生的满意情绪，已因据报道该省新军事领导人之间存在摩擦而转为不确定感。在这种情况下，孙中山博士不太可能听从其部分追随者建议前往福州，而是将留在上海等待事态发展，预计明年春季会有变化，届时人们认为张宗昌将军将再次尝试掌控中央政府。据说张正在训练一支大军以征服吴佩孚，而他的国民党及其他党派的朋友正试图通过在其辖区内煽动匪患和劳工纠纷来削弱吴的军事力量。据报道，段祺瑞的一位名为何传勋的特使于11月16日作为客人参加了孙中山博士举办的聚会，而据信身在上海的徐树铮（别名小徐）未接受邀请，尽管寻找他的努力并未成功。
本周其他国民党活动包括筹备举行吴廷芳博士的追悼会，以及由George Mau Hsien夫人安排在12月1日于爱德华七世路1898号开设一所妇女参政权主义者学校。
有可靠消息报道，当地中国海员工会分会主席林伟明，法国警方已持逮捕令通缉多时，已前往南京，将在该港口的中国海员工会分会接管社会部主席一职。林的朋友称他于11月16日乘“麦金莱总统”号离开，但在航运办事处的查询未能证实此事。林在上海中国海员工会分会的主席职务将由陈炳生继任，陈曾在广州杀害其妻。

pages.en:
38

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending Nov. 13, 1922.

Local members of the Kuomintang including Dr. Sun Yat
Sen, are reported to consider the changes in Fukien a great
success for their party.

Antagonism towards Hsu Shu Tseng (徐樹錚) alias Little
Hsu seems to have subsided, but local political agitators
continue their attacks on Tuchun Ma Lien Kya (馬聯甲 )
of Anhwei, Tuchun Tsai Cheng Hsun (蔡成勳 ) of Kiangsi
Tuchun Hsia Yao Wen (蕭耀南 ) of Hupeh, to whom has now been
added Tuchun Chi Shih Yuan (齊燮元 ) of Kiangsu. Hsia
is accused of responsibility for the summary execution of
Kin Hou-cham (金漢章 ) at Changsha and Chi is denounced
for executing Han Kwe (韓恢 ) at Nanking.

In addition to assisting in the propaganda against these
officials, the Kuomintang press has recently devoted consider-
able space to reports of the activities of bandits in Anhwei
and Honan who, in the intervals between marauding expeditions,
seem to pass their time harassing militarists friendly to the
Central Government. These brigands are said to be numerous
and well organized and are credited with ability to influence
military situation. A marked increase in arms smuggling here
would seem to indicate that there is a movement afoot to make
Shanghai a base for supplying these or other unauthorized
persons with arms.

Hostility to Chen Chuan Ming of Canton continues unabated
among local Kuomintang cliques who are now spreading reports
that the British Minister disapproves of the action, alleged
to have been taken by Dr. Jamieson, British Consul General of
Canton, in the loan negotiations, and a threat is made that
Chinese opposed to the loan are making arrangements to have
his conduct made the subject of a question in the House when
parliament re-assembles after the elections.
pages.zh:
38

截至1922年11月13日的一周内
孙中山博士的活动。

据报道，包括孙中山博士在内的当地国民党成员认为福建的变化对其政党是一大成功。

对徐树铮（别名小徐）的敌意似乎已平息，但当地政治煽动者继续攻击安徽督军马联甲、江西督军蔡成勋、湖北督军萧耀南，现在又加上了江苏督军齐燮元。萧被指控对在长沙就地正法金汉章负责，齐则因在南京处决韩恢而受到谴责。

除了协助进行针对这些官员的宣传外，国民党报刊最近还花费大量篇幅报道安徽和河南匪徒的活动，这些匪徒在抢劫行动的间隙，似乎将时间用于骚扰亲中央政府的军阀。据说这些匪徒数量众多且组织严密，被认为有能力影响军事局势。此地武器走私显著增加，似乎表明有一场运动正在酝酿中，旨在使上海成为向这些或其他未经授权人员提供武器的基地。

当地国民党派系中对广州陈炯明的敌意持续不减，他们现在散布谣言称，英国公使不赞成据称由英国驻广州总领事Jamieson博士在贷款谈判中采取的行动，并威胁称，反对贷款的中国人士正安排在英国议会选举后重新集会时，就其行为提出质询。

Callers at Dr. Sun Yat Sen's home in the Rue Moliere,
French Town, on Nov. 10 included three Japanese who remained
there from noon till 3 p.m. The names of these have not
been ascertained, but they came in two motor cars belonging
to F. Tanaka, Japanese Vice Consul, and F. Yoneda, No. 5

A report that Hsu Shu-tseng (徐樹錚) alias Little Hsu
has left Fukien and came to Shanghai is now being verified.

The Shanghai Gazette, the local organ in English of the
Kuomintang, and the Evening Star have merged and the combined
newspapers are now appear under the name of the "Evening News".

关于徐树铮（别名小徐）已离开福建来到上海的报道目前正在核实中。

《上海公报》（当地国民党英文机关报）与《 Evening Star 》已合并，合并后的报纸现在以《 Evening News 》的名义出版。

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending Nov. 6 , 1922.

Dr. Sun Yat Sen seems to be very disturbed by the reports
about his communist proclivities. Not content with the
public refutation of any intention on his part to establish
a Soviet Republic made some time ago he has within the week
under review again sent a communication to the press denying
that the propagation of Bolshevism is part of the policy of the
Kuomintang party. He admits that some individual members
as may hold such views, but asserts that neither he nor the
other prominent leaders have any faith in the communist
doctrine. It is noteworthy that the second disavowal of
communist connections by the Kuomintang chief synchronised
with visits made to his place by Mr John J. Abbott, Vice
President of the Continental and Commercial Bank of Chicago,
who is living in the Astor House.

Happenings during the week indicate that the efforts of
the Kuomintang to extend its influence in Shanghai are meeting
with some success. Zau Sen Koong, who for some years has
acted as agent here for the sale of Kuomintang literature
has been selected by a meeting attended by representatives
of all local labour bodies to proceed to Peking to press a
demand for the cancellation of statutes prejudicial to the
labour movement in the Chinese Provisional Criminal Code.
George Hau Hsien is in demand as a lecturer, among addresses
he delivered recently being one before the students of the
Soochow Comparative Law School. Another Kuomintang who
seems to be popular is Dr. C. C. Wu, son of Dr. Wu Ting Fang,
who was entertained to dinner a few days ago by the Chinese
Ratepayers Association. K. P. Chen, who presided at the
function, is a member of the Chinese Advisory Committee to the
S. M. C.

Local societies under Kuomintang influence seem to have

截至1922年11月6日的一周内
孙中山博士的活动。

孙中山博士似乎对有关其共产主义倾向的报道感到非常不安。他不满足于不久前公开驳斥任何建立苏维埃共和国的意图，在本周审查期间，他再次向新闻界发送通讯，否认传播布尔什维克主义是国民党政策的一部分。他承认个别成员可能持有此类观点，但断言他本人及其他重要领导人对共产主义学说没有任何信仰。值得注意的是，国民党领袖第二次否认与共产主义有关联，恰逢芝加哥大陆商业银行副总裁John J. Abbott先生拜访其住所，Abbot先生现居住于礼查饭店。

本周的事件表明，国民党扩大其在上海影响力的努力取得了一些成功。Zau Sen Koong多年来一直在此地代理销售国民党文献，他被一个由所有当地劳工团体代表参加的会议选中，前往北京，要求废除《中华民国暂行新刑律》中损害劳工运动的法规。George Hau Hsien作为讲师备受需求，他最近发表的演讲包括在东吴比较法学院学生面前的一次演讲。另一位似乎颇受欢迎的国民党人是吴廷芳博士之子C. C. Wu博士，几天前他受邀参加华人纳税会的晚宴。主持该活动的K. P. Chen是工部局华务顾问委员会成员。

受国民党影响的当地社团似乎

great faith in General Hsu Chung Chi (          ) of Foochow.
The Fokienese Guild has appealed to him to drive Hsu
(little Hsu) out of their province, while the Cantonese Self-
Government Club urges that he should devote himself to the
task of ridding their birth place of Chen Chuen Ming.
    The local Kiangse men are still denouncing Tuhai Tsai
Chan Hsuan , and have decided to ask the assistance of societies
of their fellow provincials all over the country to assist in
pressing home the attack.
    It is reported that Han Hwe, one of Dr. Sun's most
prominent helpers, was executed at Nanking on October 30.
A rumour that he was kidnapped from Shanghai has not been
confirmed.
    Denunciations of General Chen Chuen Ming of Canton are
still a daily feature in the local Kuomintang press.

对福州的许崇智将军抱有极大信心。福建同乡会呼吁他将徐（小徐）驱逐出该省，而广东自治俱乐部则敦促他致力于从其出生地清除陈炯明。
当地江西人仍在谴责督军蔡成勋，并决定请求全国各地同乡社团协助，以加强攻击力度。

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending October 30, 1922.

Prominent members of the Kuomintang continue to leave
for Fokien, the most notable persons departing during the
past week being Wong Ching Wai (汪精衛), who recently visited
Mukden, Ho Hai Ming (胡漢民), Dr. Sun's delegate to Tuan Chi
Jui (段祺瑞), Chu Tseng (居正) and Tsu Tsheh Vung (朱執信).
Qua Tai Chin (鄧泰祺) and Chang Chi (張繼), two more of
those recently entrusted with missions to influential
politicians and militarists by Dr. Sun Yat Sen, are now back
in Shanghai to which George Hsu Hsien (徐謙), the Christian
barrister, has also returned.

Local Kiangsi and Anhui societies organized by the
Kuomintang continue to spread propaganda against Tupan Tsai
Chen Hsun (蔡成勳) and other officials friendly to Wu Pei
Fu (吳佩孚), while the Hupeh Reconstruction Society, another
organization under Kuomintang influence, is using similar
tactics against Tupan Hsiao Yao Nen (蕭耀南).

The Shanghai newspapers controlled by the Kuomintang
print exaggerated reports about the doings of these
associations and thus manage to give a false impression of
their importance and strength. The same papers almost
daily publish attacks on the President Li Yuen Hung (黎元洪),
who is described as the "Peking Blunderer", and their
attitude towards Chen Chiung-ming (陳炯明) of Canton may
be gauged from the following leading article published in
the Min Kuo Pao (民國報) and reproduced in English in the
Shanghai Gazette:-

" Traitor Chen Chiung Ming Barters Away Kwangtung.

1922年10月30日截止当周孙中山博士的活动。

国民党要员继续前往福建，上周离沪的最著名人物包括汪精卫（Wong Ching Wai），他最近访问了奉天；胡汉民（Ho Hai Ming），孙中山派往段祺瑞（Tuan Chi Jui）处的代表；居正（Chu Tseng）和朱执信（Tsu Tsheh Vung）。邓泰祺（Qua Tai Chin）和张继（Chang Chi）是另外两位最近受孙中山委托去联络有影响力的政客和军阀的人，他们现已回到上海，基督教律师徐谦（George Hsu Hsien）也已返回上海。

由国民党组织的本地江西和安徽同乡会继续散布宣传，反对督军蔡成勋（Tupan Tsai Chen Hsun）及其他与吴佩孚（Wu Pei Fu）友好的官员；而另一受国民党影响的组织湖北重建协会，正采用类似手段对付督军萧耀南（Tupan Hsiao Yao Nen）。

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending October 23, 1923.

There are indications that the capture of Fukien
by the Southerners and their allies is likely to detract
from the importance of Shanghai as a centre of Kuomintang
activities. Societies in Fukien are reported to have
invited Dr. Sun to go there and assist in the rehabili-
tation of that province, while Li Lieh Chun (李烈鈞),
who previous to Chen Chuin Ming's coup at Canton commanded
the anti-Northern Expedition, has already left and is
reported to be in Hongkong. Chen To Sou (陳獨秀), Sun's
Bolshevik confederate, has proceeded to Anhwei where the
Kuomintangs are said to be endeavouring to undermine the
authority of officials friendly to Wu Pei Fu. The
departure from Shanghai has also been noted of a prominent
partisan of Dr. Sun named Chiang Ts Ping (致平), who
formerly held a post as Garrison Commander in Amoy.
Local Kuomintangs however seem at present somewhat uncertain
about the benefits which the Fukien victory will bring, and
in some circles it is thought that it may lead to a
quarrel between Sun's followers and their Northern allies.
Since the fall of Foochow Kuomintangs in Shanghai have
organized meetings of local natives of Fukien rallying to
the catch cry "Fukien for the Fukienese" passed resolutions
opposing the formation of a government in Foochow by
Hsu Shu Tseng (徐樹錚) or General Wang Yung Chi
(王永泉) and urging the Kuomintang generals in Fukien,
including Hsu Chung Chi (許崇智) and Wang Yung Tien
(王永泉) to take active measures to ensure that their
wishes in this matter are respected. Another local society
called the Kiangsu Self-Government Association seems to

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen
Bulletin; Vol: In Ling; October 10, 1922.

Happenings during the past week indicate that
the efforts of delegates sent by Dr. Sun Yat Sen on
a mission to highly placed militarists and prominent
politicians have been rewarded with some measure of
success. Wang Chao Ming (汪兆銘) is stated to have
succeeded in effecting an understanding for a triple
alliance between Chang Tso Lin (張作霖), Tuan Chi
Jui (段祺瑞) and Dr. Sun Yat Sen. Kuo Tai Chi
(郭泰祺), another of the emissaries, who formerly
held an appointment as private secretary to Dr. Sun

about to resume his old official relations with the

Ziang (盧永祥), according to the following newspaper
report, appears to be openly supporting Dr. Sun Yat Sen
and Tuan Chi Jui :-

By wire from Peking October 10.

"Lu Yung Hsiang, Tupan of the Rehabilitation of

protect the locality and to support the self-government
movement. He has always expected that his colleagues will
co-operate with him in following the trend of the general
situation in the hope that the aggressive ones will be
awakened. He adds that the developments in the situation

Arrangements for the observance of October 10, the
anniversary of the foundation of the Republic, are being
pushed forward by sub-committees appointed for this purpose
at a joint meeting of local societies which was attended
by representatives of Kuomintang, labour and Street Union
organizations friendly to Dr. Sun Yat Sen. Consequently
announcements that advantage will be taken of the celebration
to press the demand for the disbandment of soldiers is not
a cause for surprise. It appears to be the plan of Kuoming-
tangs to use this popular cry as a cloak for propaganda
against officials hostile to their party so as to prepare
the way for movements in other parts of the country similar
to the one which threatens the downfall of Li Hou Chi
in Fukien, an occurrence, which Dr. Sun's partisans will
help to restore the prestige which he lost through his
flight from Canton.

“一家英文出版的北京日报声称，孙中山代表前往奉天、天津、北京、保定、洛阳和杭州目前的使命，不仅仅像报道所说的那样是对各位领导人的回访。该报继续称 ____ ‘孙中山一直在与各方谈判。他**〔此处转录不清〕**深信，依靠 brute force（武力）实现统一，或依靠任何特定党派（无论其多么强大）的影响力来控制局势，都是徒劳的。他已向所有党派领导人提议召开一次各省会议**〔此处转录不清〕**，以解决当前所有悬而未决的问题。预计他的提议将获得他们所有人的批准 ____ 孙中山将再次成为重要人物’。”

Summary of Political Happenings in
Shanghai during September, 1922.

As might be expected, the return of Dr. Sun Yat
Sen to Shanghai and the defeat of his party in the South
has led to a concentration in this city of discontented
and demoralised politicians, who during their forced re-
linquishment of power are gratifying their desire for in-
trigue by organizing societies and starting agitations
of various descriptions.

The movements inspired by these trouble-makers in-
clude : a campaign against Li Hou Chi (李厚基 ), Tuchun of
Fokien ; opposition to the appointment of Li Ting Yok (李廷玉 )
to the Governorship of Kiangse ; and demands for the resto-
ration of the Shanghai Mixed Court to Chinese control and
the "arrest of foreign expansion" by the construction of a
highway around the Settlement.

To further these and other plans, a number of new
societies have been created, including the Shanghai Central
Labour Organization, The Women's Suffrage Association, and
the Anhwei Soldiers' Disbandment Association , while use
is also being made of old organizations friendly to the
Kuomintang.

Suspicions long entertained of Dr. Sun's pro-Bolshe-
vist sympathies, to which the inclusion among his organizers
in the early part of the month of the notorious communist
Chen To Seu (陳獨秀 )gave colour, were practically confirmed
towards the end of the month by disclosures showing that he
had endeavoured to bring about an alliance of Germany, Russia,
and China. Although denying any intention to make China a
Communist state, the ex-President admits that the disclo-
sures are partially true. Strangely, however, he does
not seem to fear that they will seriously affect his position
for he is still proceeding with his plans to capture the
presidency.
pages.zh:
21

1922年9月上海政治事件摘要。

正如预期的那样，孙中山返回上海及其政党在南方的失败，导致不满和士气低落的政治家集中于此城，他们在被迫放弃权力期间，通过组织社团和发起各种形式的 agitation（煽动/运动）来满足其阴谋诡计的欲望。

由这些捣乱分子激发的运动包括：反对福建督军李厚基的运动；反对任命李廷玉为江西督军的运动；以及要求将上海会审公廨收回中国控制，并通过围绕租界修建公路来“阻止外国扩张”的要求。

为了推进这些及其他计划，成立了许多新社团，包括上海中央劳工组织、妇女参政协会和安徽士兵遣散协会，同时也利用了旧有的友好于国民党的组织。

长期以来人们对孙中山亲布尔什维克倾向的怀疑，在本月初因其组织者中包括了臭名昭著的共产党人陈独秀而得到佐证，并在月底因披露他试图促成德国、俄国和中国联盟而几乎得到证实。虽然否认有意将中国变成共产主义国家，这位前总统承认披露内容部分属实。然而奇怪的是，他似乎并不担心这会严重影响他的地位，因为他仍在继续其夺取总统职位的计划。

The movement in favour of organizing a meeting
in honour of Dr. Sun Yat's return to Shanghai was temporarily
abandoned on September 28 when its promoters decided that it
would be unwise to hold the function owing to the opposition
of the police of the Settlement, Frenchtown, and Chinese
territory.

Dr. Sun Yat Sen and the bulk of his helpers are
living in places outside municipal control but two of the
latter named Li Lieh Chum (李烈鈞) and Sung Woo (孫武), who
during the month were located in the Settlement, were warned
to abstain from political activities whilst availing of
foreign protection.

9月28日，鉴于租界、法租界和华界警方的反对，举办纪念孙中山返回上海会议的倡议者决定举行该活动是不明智的，因此暂时放弃了组织该会议的运动。

孙中山及其大部分助手居住在市政管辖范围之外的地方，但本月位于租界内的两名助手李烈钧和孙武受到警告，要求在享受外国保护期间 abstain from（避免/停止）政治活动。

Summary Account of Strikes Occurring in
Shanghai During the Month of September, 1923.

About 600 sawyers and box makers employed by the
China Import and Export Lumber Co., lower Mill, 92A Yang-
tszepoo Road, struck work on August 31 and resumed work on
September 2. Harshness in inflicting fines for unpunctuality
by a new foreign overseer was the pretext put forward by the
strikers for their conduct.

About 500 female workers employed at the Wei Kee
Jien Nyou Filature, No. 5 Markham Road struck work at 1 p.m.
September 3, over a decision of the management to increase
their working hours by two per day and compensate them at the
rate of ten cents per day for overtime. Work was resumed two
hours later after the management promised to abandon their
scheme for increasing the working time.

About two hundred employees of the Chinese Tramway
(Chinese territory)
Company, Nantao, struck work on the morning of September 16
to enforce a demand for an increase of wages. Through the media-
tion of the Military and Police Authorities the strike ended
at 6.30 p.m. September 17, the representatives of the Company
having agreed to give an increase of $ 2.00 per month to con-
ductors and motormen, and $ 3.00 to inspectors, which is
equivalent to a rise of about 20 per cent.

Three hundred women employed in the Spinning Depart-
ment of the Da Kong Cotton Mill, 91A Yangtszepoo Road, struck
work at 10 p.m. September 28 as a protest against a proposed
reduction of their wages. Having gained their object the stri-
kers resumed on the old scale of wages on October 1.

1923年9月上海罢工事件综述。

杨树浦路92A号下厂中国进出口木材公司（China Import and Export Lumber Co.）雇用的约600名锯木工人和制箱工人于8月31日罢工，并于9月2日复工。罢工者为其行为提出的借口是，一名新来的外籍监工对不守时行为处以罚款，手段严苛。

马克姆路5号纬记缫丝厂（Wei Kee Jien Nyou Filature）雇用的约500名女工于9月3日下午1时罢工，抗议管理层决定将每日工作时间延长两小时，并按每天一角钱的标准支付加班费。在管理层承诺放弃增加工时的计划后，两小时后复工。

南市华商电车公司（Chinese Tramway Company，华界）的约二百名员工于9月16日上午罢工，以强制要求增加工资。经军警当局调解，罢工于9月17日下午6时30分结束，公司代表同意每月给售票员和司机加薪2.00元，给查票员加薪3.00元，相当于加薪约20%。

杨树浦路91A号大康纱厂（Da Kong Cotton Mill）纺纱部雇用的三百名女工于9月28日晚上10时罢工，抗议拟议中的减薪。由于达到了目的，罢工者于10月1日按原工资标准复工。

pages.en:
18

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending October 2, 1922.

In addition to organizing their supporters in the
Kiangso and Fukien Guilds, the Kuomintang has during the
week formed a number of new societies to further its
interests. The new associations consist of :-

1- The Shanghai Labour Organization, the bulk of whose
promoters including six ex-"1919" M. P.s are known to be
friendly to Dr. Sun.

2- The Women's Suffrage Association, of which Madam Huang
Hsin, a famous Kuomintang, is one of the founders.

3- Shanghai Society for the Disbandment of Soldiers and
Abolition of Tuchunate in Anhwei, formed by Pah Yung Wei
(柏文蔚), one of Dr. Sun's oldest lieutenants.

All these societies are at present busy on Dr. Sun's
behalf. His henchmen in the Fukien Guild have passed
resolutions denouncing Li Hou Chi (李厚基) of that province,
and have issued a manifesto accusing him of numerous crimes
against the people and the nation. Tuchun Chang Vung Sung
(张文生) of Anhui has been condemned in similar terms by
the Anhwei Society, while Dr. Sun's friends in the Kiangso
Guild are endeavouring to arouse hostility to Lee Ding Nyoh
(李廷玉), a likely candidate for Civil Governorship of
Kiangso. Other agitations such as the demand for the can-
cellation of foreign control of the Mixed Court and for
the construction of a road around the Settlements, believed
to have been inspired by Dr. Sun's followers, are being
continued.

Unrest prevailing in other parts of the country
is also undoubtedly being fomented by Dr. Sun who meanwhile
is trying to find friends among the Northern militarists.
pages.zh:
18

截至1922年10月2日的一周内孙中山博士的活动。

国民党除了在江苏和福建同乡会中组织其支持者外，本周还成立了一些新社团以推进其利益。这些新协会包括：

1- 上海劳工组织，其大部分发起人（包括六名前“1919年”议员）已知对孙博士持友好态度。

2- 女子参政协会，著名国民党人黄兴夫人是该协会的创始人之一。

3- 安徽裁兵废督社，由孙博士最资深的副手之一柏文蔚（Pah Yung Wei）组建。

目前所有这些社团都在为孙博士忙碌。他在福建同乡会中的亲信已通过决议，谴责该省的李厚基（Li Hou Chi），并发布宣言指控他犯下许多危害人民和国家的罪行。安徽督军张文生（Chang Vung Sung）也遭到安徽同乡会以类似的措辞谴责，而孙博士在江苏同乡会中的朋友正试图激起对李廷玉（Lee Ding Nyoh）的敌意，李是江苏省长一职的可能候选人。其他一些据信由孙博士追随者煽动的 agitation（煽动/运动），如要求取消外国人对会审公廨的控制以及在租界周围修筑道路等，仍在继续。

国内其他地区普遍存在的不安局势，无疑也正由孙博士煽动，与此同时，他正试图在北方军阀中寻找朋友。

pages.en:
17

It is authoratively reported that during the week a member
of his prominent supporters, viz, Kuo Tai Chi (郭泰祺),
Ho Hai Ning (胡漢民), Wong Chao Ming (汪兆銘), Chang Chi
(張繼) and Ma Chun Wu (馬君武) left here for the north
to take return calls on Li Yuan Hung, Acting President,
Tuan Chi Jui (段祺瑞), ex-Premier, Chang Tso Ling (張作霖),
Tuchun of Manchuria, General Wu Pei Fu (吳佩孚), and
Tuchun Tsao Kun of Chili, who had sent emissaries to convey
their courtesies to the Doctor when he returned to Shanghai.

One of Dr. Sun's most important visitors during the
past week, of whom there were several is stated to be one
Han Chung Ling (韓麟春), Director of the Fengtien Arsenal,
who is also reported to have been also negotiating with the
Chelkiang Authorities.

It is said that considerable alarm prevailed for a
day or two in Dr. Sun's headquarters at No. 29 Rue Pottiere,
after the appearance of reports in the newspapers giving an
outline of his policy towards Germany and Russia. The
disclosures made in these reports has aroused considerable
hostility to the Doctor in local French circles. The
following article translated from the Echo de Chine of Sept.
28 is evidence of this :-

"Dr. Sun, a pro-German and a Bolshevik.

"At last it is learned from a British newspaper
"The Hongkong Telegraph" (which may have got its information
from the Echo de Chine) that Dr. Sun Yat Sen seeks to ally
China with Germany and Soviet Russia, the two worst enemies
of France. At the most critical period of the war, i.e.
in 1917, a Cantonese lieutenant of Sun Yat Sen attempted to
send arms and ammunitions not only to India, but to Indo-
China also. The scheme miscarried, thanks to the indiscretion
of a neutral and the patriotism of a Frenchman. Sun Yat Sen
in view of this antecedents, has no more right to enjoy
pages.zh:
17

据权威消息报道，本周内他的一些重要支持者，即郭泰祺（Kuo Tai Chi）、胡汉民（Ho Hai Ning）、汪兆铭（Wong Chao Ming）、张继（Chang Chi）和马君武（Ma Chun Wu）离开此地前往北方，回访黎元洪（代理总统）、段祺瑞（Tuan Chi Jui，前总理）、张作霖（Chang Tso Ling，满洲督军）、吴佩孚将军（General Wu Pei Fu）以及直隶督军曹锟（Tsao Kun），这些人在孙博士返回上海时曾派遣使者向其致意。

上周孙博士最重要的访客之一（此类访客有数位）据称是奉天兵工厂总监韩麟春（Han Chung Ling），另有报道称他也一直在与浙江当局进行谈判。

据说，在报纸刊登概述其对德国和俄罗斯政策的文章后，孙博士位于波提埃路29号（Rue Pottiere No. 29）的总部曾有一两天陷入相当大的恐慌。这些报道中的披露在当地法国圈子中激起了对孙博士的相当敌意。以下译自9月28日《中法新汇报》（Echo de Chine）的文章即为证据：

“孙博士：亲德派与布尔什维克。

“最后，从一家英国报纸《香港电讯报》（The Hongkong Telegraph，其消息可能来自《中法新汇报》）获悉，孙逸仙博士寻求使中国与德国和苏维埃俄罗斯结盟，而这两国是法国最凶恶的敌人。在战争最关键的时期，即1917年，孙逸仙的一名广东籍副官曾试图不仅向印度，而且向印度支那运送武器弹药。由于一名中立国人士的不慎和一名法国人的爱国精神，该阴谋未能得逞。鉴于此等前科，孙逸仙不再有权享受

pages.en:
16

the immunities accorded to drawers for he is a dangerous
person. He has proved it several times, and does not
deserve our friendship.

"The documents establishing the guilt of Sun Yat Sen
should be examined with the utmost impartiality and if they
are found to be authentic, let justice take its course,
because Sun's presence in Shanghai has created and will
create extraordinary complications. If chased away from
Shanghai Sun will not be able to seek refuge at Macao, which
belongs to one of our most faithful allies, the Portuguese,
whose patience he has exhausted. His only recourse will
be to go to America where we wish him a good and long
sojourn." A.V. ( ? A. Vandeleur, editor).

"In a published statement commenting on the
disclosures in the newspapers Dr. Sun Yat Sen does not
deny that negotiations were entered into with Germany
and Moscow. He concedes the existence of letters of the
character published, and he sets forth plainly that he
favours a rapprochement of China, Soviet Russia and Germany."

Dr. Sun's sympathizers have finally abandoned the
idea of according him a public welcome, giving as an excuse
for this decision the opposition of the police of the Settle-
ment, French Town and Chinese territory to the holding of such
a function.
pages.zh:
16

给予流亡者的豁免权，因为他是一个危险人物。他已多次证明这一点，不值得我们要好。

“确立孙逸仙罪责的文件应受到最公正的审查，如果证实属实，就让法律程序进行下去，因为孙在上海的存在已经造成并将造成非凡的复杂局面。如果被赶出上海，孙将无法寻求避难于澳门，澳门属于我们最忠实的盟友之一葡萄牙，而他对葡萄牙人的耐心已消耗殆尽。他唯一的出路是去美国，我们祝他在那里度过美好而漫长的时光。” A.V.（？A. Vandeleur，编辑）。

“在一份就报纸披露内容发表评论的公开声明中，孙逸仙博士并不否认已与德国和莫斯科进行谈判。他承认存在性质如所公布信件那样的信函，并明确表示他赞成中国、苏维埃俄罗斯和德国之间的和解。”

孙博士的支持者最终放弃了为他举行公开欢迎仪式的想法，以此为决定的借口的是租界、法租界和华界警方反对举行此类活动。

pages.en:
15

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During
Week Ending September 25, 1922.

Efforts believed to have been inspired by Dr. Sun
Yat Sen to restore peace between the Old and New Amal-
gamated Association of Street Unions having proved
unsuccessful, attempts are now being made to find a
rallying cry to which all will respond by starting
agitations favouring the return of the Mixed Court to
Chinese control and the construction of a road around
the Settlement.

Li Lieh Chun( 李烈鈞 ), one of Dr. Sun's most
important military followers, is now living in a Japanese
hotel situated on the outskirts of the town. Callers
at his hotel are received by Tsiang Tsung K'wei( 蔣尊簋 ),
alias Pah Chi( 百痴 ), a native of Chekiang who tells
them that Li is unfit to see anybody. Tsiang led
the insurrection in Ningpo in 1916 and was Assistant
Chief of Staff to the Southern Military Government
while Dr. Sun Yat Sen was in power in Canton. Visitors
to his private residence, No. 16 Gordon Road, are
received by Lieu Zoong Sung( 劉仲生 ), a close relation
of Li and Chief of his personal staff. Both Li and
another follower of Dr. Sun's named Sung Woo( 宋武 ),
a native of Hupeh who came to reside in the Wei Tsang
Hotel, 56 Shantung Road, about a week ago, have been
warned against engaging in political activities, whilst
living in the Settlement. This warning, however, is
not likely to hamper in any way the efforts of Dr. Sun
Yat Sen, whose partisans and helpers are almost all
residents of the French Concession. One of these who
pages.zh:
15

截至1922年9月25日的一周内孙中山博士的活动。

据信由孙逸仙博士发起、旨在恢复旧工会联合会与新工会联合会之间和平的努力既已证明无效，目前正试图寻找一个能让所有人响应的号召性口号，方法是发起有利于将会审公廨归还中国控制以及在租界周围修筑道路的 agitation（运动/煽动）。

李烈钧（Li Lieh Chun），孙博士最重要的军事追随者之一，现居住在位于市郊的一家日本旅馆。前往其旅馆拜访者由蒋尊簋（Tsiang Tsung K'wei），别名百痴（Pah Chi），浙江人接待，他告诉来访者李不适合见任何人。蒋曾在1916年领导宁波起义，并在孙逸仙博士在广州掌权期间担任南方军政府参谋次长。前往其戈登路16号私人寓所的访客由刘仲生（Lieu Zoong Sung）接待，刘是李的近亲兼其个人幕僚长。李和孙博士的另一名追随者宋武（Sung Woo），湖北人，约一周前入住山东路56号伟藏旅馆（Wei Tsang Hotel），两人均被警告在居住于租界期间不得从事政治活动。然而，这一警告不太可能以任何方式阻碍孙逸仙博士的努力，他的党徒和助手几乎都居住在法租界。其中一位在本周因领导在租界周围修筑道路的运动而崭露头角的人是

pages.en:
14

brought himself into prominence during the week by
leading the campaign for the construction of a road
around the Settlement, is George Hsu Chien (徐謙).
No. 5 Rue Dollfus. Hsu Chien is a barrister by
profession and a Christian. He formerly held a
high post in the Ministry of Justice in Peking, and
was recently Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in
Canton.

It is reported in Hankow that in order to seal
his friendship with Dr. Sun Yat Sen, General Wu Pei-fu
sent a telegram on Sep. 13 to Tuchun Siao Yao Han of
Wuchang informing him that Dr. Sun is in a most
impecunious state in Shanghai and instructing him to
remit to Shanghai without fail within three days
$100,000 of Hupeh funds to the retired president of
the South. According to reports in Hankow a definite
friendly understanding has been arrived at between
General Wu Pei Fu and Dr. Sun Yat Sen with whom
Marshal Tsao Kun is also joining hands. The object
of the partnership of the three is said to be the final
upset of Chang Tso Lin and the stop of the ever
spreading movement of autonomous government in the
provinces.
pages.zh:
14

徐谦（George Hsu Chien），住址多尔富斯路5号（Rue Dollfus No. 5）。徐谦职业为律师，也是一名基督徒。他曾任北京司法部高官，最近任广州最高法院首席法官。

据汉口报道，为了巩固与孙逸仙博士的友谊，吴佩孚将军于9月13日向武昌督军萧耀南（Siao Yao Han）发出电报，告知孙博士在上海处于极度贫困状态，并指示他务必在三天内从湖北款项中汇寄10万元给这位南方前总统。据汉口报道，吴佩孚将军与孙逸仙博士之间已达成明确的友好谅解，曹锟元帅也加入其中。据说这三方结盟的目的是最终推翻张作霖，并制止各省日益蔓延的自治运动。

pages.en:
13

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen for
Week Ending September 16, 1922.

Ever since his return to China after the overthrow
of the Manchus in 1911, Dr. Sun Yat Sen, apparently
considering that the assistance of the working classes
would be useful in furthering his political aspirations,
has always kept in touch with labour, and at times appeared
to be decidedly sympathetic to that movement. For the
past few years he seems to have consistently supported
the working classes whose organization and influence
increased prodigiously in Canton while he was in power
in that city. Events during the past week seem to
indicate that Sun now intends to make his relations
with the labourites more intimate than ever before.
In effecting a reorganization of his supporters necessitated
by recent changes, there is good reason to believe that
Dr. Sun, notwithstanding objections of some of his
followers, has enlisted the support of Chen To Seu
(陳獨秀), the leader of the Chinese Communist party.
For the past few years Chen has been actively engaged
sowing the seeds of Bolshevism in China by propaganda,
not only among workers, students, but also soldiers whose
illiteracy has so far saved them from contamination.
There is no doubt that very cordial relations exist
between Chen and Soviet Authorities in Moscow who are
said to have liberally supplied him with funds. There
is good reason to believe that a newspaper called "The
Guide Weekly" which started publication in Shanghai on
September 14, is edited by Chen To Seu and financed by
Dr. Sun. The first issue of this paper contains a

13

截至1922年9月16日的一周内孙中山博士的活动。

自从1911年推翻满清统治返回中国以来，孙逸仙博士显然认为工人阶级的援助有助于推进其政治抱负，因此一直与劳工界保持联系，有时甚至表现出对该运动的明显同情。在过去几年里，他似乎一贯支持工人阶级，而在他主政广州期间，广州的工人阶级组织和影响力急剧增长。过去一周的事件似乎表明，孙现在打算使其与劳工界的关系比以往任何时候都更加密切。在因近期变化而对其支持者进行重组的过程中，有充分理由相信，尽管遭到部分追随者的反对，孙博士已争取到中国共产党领导人陈独秀（Chen To Seu）的支持。在过去几年里，陈一直积极通过宣传在中国播撒布尔什维主义的种子，对象不仅是工人和学生，还包括士兵，而士兵的文盲状态迄今使他们免受污染。毫无疑问，陈与莫斯科的苏维埃当局之间存在非常融洽的关系，据说后者向他提供了充裕的资金。有充分理由相信，一份名为《向导周报》（The Guide Weekly）的报纸于9月14日在上海创刊，由陈独秀编辑，并由孙博士资助。该报第一期包含若干

pages.en:
12

number of articles which are in the nature of Kuomintang
propaganda.

Since the return of Dr. Sun Yat Sen to Shanghai,
propaganda in favour of a revival of the Street Unions
movement has been in progress, and efforts are now being
made to effect a reconciliation of two rival federations
of Street Unions which have been working in opposition
for the past two years. Previous to the split the
Federation of Street Unions took an active part in
pressing for Chinese representation on the Municipal
Council and once took a leading part in a campaign to
further this agitation which took the form of a strike
against the payment of Municipal taxes.

Dr. Sun Yat Sen's lieutenants continue to
come to Shanghai. The latest arrival is Li Lieh Chun
(李烈钧), who was Tutuh of Kiangse in 1913 and who acted
recently as Commander-in-chief of the anti-Northern
Expeditionary Forces.

Dr. Sun's sympathizers have not yet succeeded
in finding a suitable venue for the public welcome in
his honour.
pages.zh:
12

具有国民党宣传性质的文章。

自从孙逸仙博士返回上海以来，有利于复兴马路工会运动的宣传一直在进行，目前正努力调和两个在过去两年中对立运作的马路工会联合会。在分裂之前，马路工会联合会在争取在市议会中拥有华人代表方面发挥了积极作用，并曾在一场以促进这一 agitation（运动）为目的的活动中发挥主导作用，该活动采取了抵制缴纳市政税的罢工形式。

孙逸仙博士的副手们继续来到上海。最新抵达的是李烈钧（Li Lieh Chun），他曾在1913年担任江西都督，最近曾任北伐军总司令。

孙博士的支持者尚未找到适合举行公开欢迎仪式的场所。

11

Activities of Dr. Sun Yat Sen During Week Ending Sept. 11, 1922.

Despite professions of satisfaction with the programme
of the present Government, it is reported that Dr. Sun Yat Sen
is now scheming to cause its downfall and secure his own eleva-
tion to the presidency. Considering Wu Pei Fu the most
serious obstacle to his ambition, Sun is making studied efforts
to cause a split among his supporters and discredit his work.
Sun's programme for weakening Wu and destroying the present
Government consists of propaganda opposing foreign loans and
favouring the abolition of the Tuchuns and the disbandment
of the troops, and also is said to include plans using
dissatisfied parliamentarians to harass the government with
every weapon at their disposal. Dr. Sun's desire for the
overthrow of the Peking Government is said to be shared by
Tuan Chi Jui (段祺瑞), Chang Tso Lin (張作霖), Little Hsu
(徐樹錚) and Lu Yung Hsiang (盧永祥). It is said, however,
that, apart from their dislike of China's present rulers, these
have very little in common with Dr. Sun and the measure of
support they will afford him will depend on how far he is
able to assist in the advancement of their own interests.
Sun's personal helpers and advisers consist at present of
Chu Tseng (居正), Pah Yung Wei (柏文蔚), Tsang Foo Zien
(張博泉) and Sung Hang Yi (宋漢伊).

Assistants of lesser importance include :-
Eugene Chen (陳友仁), Hsieh Chi (謝持), Chiang Tseng Kwei
(尊簋), Chen Chien (程潛), Liao Chung Kai (廖仲), Hsu
Chien (徐謙), Lai Tsao (呂超), Tien Tung (田桐), Tsiang
Tso Ping (蔣作賓) and Quo Tai Chi (郭泰祺).

Dr. Sun's residence is visited by many Chinese daily,
while a number of Japanese and a few foreigners call there from
time to time.
pages.zh:
11

截至1922年9月11日当周孙中山博士的活动。

尽管声称对现政府的施政纲领感到满意，但据报孙中山博士正策划推翻现政府，以确保自己登上总统宝座。鉴于吴佩孚是其野心的最大障碍，孙正刻意努力在其支持者中制造分裂，并破坏其工作。孙为削弱吴佩孚并摧毁现政府而制定的计划包括开展反对举借外债、主张废除督军及裁撤军队的宣传，据说还包括利用不满的议员动用一切可用手段骚扰政府的计划。据说，段祺瑞（Tuan Chi Jui）、张作霖（Chang Tso Lin）、徐树铮（Little Hsu）和卢永祥（Lu Yung Hsiang）也抱有推翻北京政府的愿望。然而，据说除了对中国现任统治者的厌恶之外，这些人与孙中山博士几乎没有共同之处，他们给予孙的支持程度将取决于孙能在多大程度上帮助推进他们自身的利益。孙中山目前的私人助手和顾问包括居正（Chu Tseng）、柏文蔚（Pah Yung Wei）、张博泉（Tsang Foo Zien）和宋汉伊（Sung Hang Yi）。

次要助手包括：
陈友仁（Eugene Chen）、谢持（Hsieh Chi）、蒋尊簋（Chiang Tseng Kwei）、程潜（Chen Chien）、廖仲恺（Liao Chung Kai）、徐谦（Hsu Chien）、吕超（Lai Tsao）、田桐（Tien Tung）、蒋作宾（Tsiang Tso Ping）和郭泰祺（Quo Tai Chi）。

许多中国人每天拜访孙中山博士的寓所，同时也有若干日本人和少数外国人不时前往。

10

Through their failure to find a suitable venue
for a meeting, local supporters of Dr. Sun have so far
failed to organize a demonstration to honour him with a
public welcome to Shanghai. The promoters of the project
have requested several commercial bodies and theatre
proprietors who own places suitable for meetings, for permission
to use their premises, but in every case the permission has
been declined, the people approached being always able to
put forward some plausible pretext for their refusal.

10

由于未能找到合适的会议场所，孙中山博士在当地的拥护者迄今未能组织一场公开欢迎他莅临上海的示威活动。该活动的发起人已向几家拥有适合开会场所的商业团体和剧院业主请求许可使用其场地，但在每种情况下均遭拒绝，被接洽者总能提出一些看似合理的借口来拒绝。

9.

Summary of Political Happenings in
Shanghai during August, 1922.

With the return of Dr. Sun Yat Sen to
Shanghai and the defeat of his party in the South,
political intriguers from different parts of the
country have again begun to congregate in this port.
At present Dr. Sun professes satisfaction with the
Central Government's programme for the restoration
of Parliamentary rule, etc. and is reported to have
decided not to interfere provided they take effective
measures to give effect to that programme. The
sincerity of these professions is however questionable,
for it is pretty safe to assume that Dr. Sun and his
henchmen who consist for the most part of disappointed,
discontented and demoralised politicians, are more
interested in obtaining power and office for themselves
than the establishment in China of any particular form
of Government.

At the present time Dr. Sun and his followers
appear to be actively engaged in propaganda against the
Tuchun system, and are supported in this movement by
the professional political societies and labour unions.

Chen To Seu(陳獨秀 ), an ex-professor at Peking
University and ex-Minister of Education in the Canton
Government and a notorious Chinese Bolshevist was fined
$400.00 and ordered to find guarantor for his future good
behaviour at the French Mixed Court on August 18. He
was charged with disseminating seditious literature and
a quantity of the literature found by the French Police at his
residence, 3 Yue Yang Lee(岳陽里 ), Route Vallon, Frenchtown,
was ordered to be destroyed.
pages.zh:
副本。
9.

1922年8月上海政治事件摘要。

随着孙中山博士返回上海及其党派在南方的失败，来自全国各地的政治阴谋家再次开始聚集于本埠。目前，孙中山博士声称对中央政府恢复议会统治等施政纲领感到满意，并据报已决定只要当局采取有效措施落实该纲领，便不予干涉。然而，这些声明的诚意值得怀疑，因为可以相当有把握地假定，孙中山博士及其主要由失意、不满和士气低落的政客组成的亲信，更关心的是为自己获取权力和官职，而非在中国建立某种特定形式的政府。

目前，孙中山博士及其追随者似乎正积极从事反对督军制度的宣传，并得到职业政治社团和工会在这一运动中的支持。

陈独秀（Chen To Seu），前北京大学教授、前广东政府教育总长，也是一名臭名昭著的中国布尔什维克分子，于8月18日在法公堂被罚款400.00美元，并被责令具保将来行为端正。他被指控散布煽动性文献，法国警察在其位于法租界华山路（Route Vallon）岳阳里3号的住所查获的大量此类文献被下令销毁。

Summary Account of Strikes Occurring in
Shanghai During Month of August, 1922.

About two hundred and forty coolies employed on cargo
boats belonging to thirteen different Chinese shipping
hongs struck work on July 31 to enforce a demand for an
increase of 30% in their wages. At a conference held on
August 3 at the Associated Shipping Guild, 41 Sen Too Lee
(三多里), Kwangtung Ka, Chapei, between representatives
of the Chinese shipping hongs and the cargo coolies, the
latter were granted an increase of 17%. They resumed work
on August 4.

Silk Filature workers in Chapei, a Chinese district
north of the Settlement, struck work on August 5 owing to
their demands for an increase of wages and shorter hours
being refused. Twenty six filatures employing about 18,000
persons were affected. On August 8 the workers began to
return to work and by August 10 the situation was almost
normal, the strikers returning to work without gaining any
concession. During the strike the silk filatures in the
Settlement remained working, though on August 7 and 8
there were isolated attempts at three filatures to enforce
a strike in sympathy with the Chapei workers. A society
called the Shanghai Women's Labour Improvement Society com-
posed of silk filature workers with headquarters at 5 Ong
Fong
Eu Inn (鸿安坊), Mongolia Road, Chapei, took an active part
in the strike. The Chapei Police, however, on August 6
removed the signboard of the society and on the same date
a proclamation issued by the Chief of the Shanghai-Woosung
Constabulary prohibiting demonstrations was posted outside
all filatures in Chapei. On August 8 four women and one man
who were alleged to have taken a leading part in instigating

1922年8月上海罢工情况摘要报告。

7月31日，受雇于十三家不同中国商号货船的约二百四十名苦力罢工，以强制要求增加30%的工资。8月3日，在北闸北广东路三多里41号的航运公会举行的一次会议上，在中国商号代表与货运苦力之间进行协商后，后者获得了17%的加薪。他们于8月4日复工。

位于租界以北中国区域闸北的缫丝厂工人，因增加工资和缩短工时的要求被拒，于8月5日罢工。受影响者包括雇佣约18,000人的二十六家缫丝厂。8月8日，工人们开始返工，至8月10日局势几乎恢复正常，罢工者在未获得任何让步的情况下复工。罢工期间，租界内的缫丝厂继续开工，尽管在8月7日和8日，有三家缫丝厂出现了试图响应闸北工人罢工的零星举动。一个名为“上海女工改良会”的社团积极参与了此次罢工，该社团由缫丝厂工人组成，总部设在闸北蒙古路鸿安坊5号。然而，闸北警方于8月6日拆除了该会的招牌，同日，淞沪警察厅厅长发布的禁止示威的公告被张贴在闸北所有缫丝厂外。8月8日，四名妇女和一名男子因涉嫌在煽动

pages.en:
7
the strike were arrested. They were eventually released
on August 9 and 14 on giving security for their future
good behaviour.

The crews of four ships owned by the China
Merchants S. N. Co. struck work on August 5 in order
to enforce a demand that their wages be raised to the
level of the rates ruling at Hongkong since March 1922
when the shipping strike in the Southern port was settled.
Several other small Chinese shipping firms were also
affected but with the exception of the San Poh Steam
Navigation Co. they all agreed to the seamen's terms at
once and their ships were only idle for a day or two. On
August 14 the San Poh S. N. Co. came to an agreement
with the Seamen's Union thus leaving the dispute
entirely between the Seamen's Union and the China Merchants
S. N. Co. In the meantime the crews of other ships
belonging to the company had walked ashore as soon as the
vessels arrived in Shanghai until on August 24 there were
twenty four of the company's steamers lying idle in the
river. The strike was eventually settled on August 25 when
an agreement was signed at the company's offices, the men
receiving the increase of pay they had asked for but it
was agreed that the increases were to date from May 1 instead
of from January 1 as at first demanded.

Chapoi depot sub-contractors who hire rickshas
from the Star Ricsha Company refused to let about 600 of
their ricshas to ricsha pullers on August 7 but on August
8 all the vehicles were working as usual. There is a good
deal of agitation in the public ricsha business, the Chinese
sub-contractors alleging that the Star Ricsha Co. over
charge for repairs, losses, etc. Negotiations are
proceeding between representatives of the contractors and
pages.zh:
7
罢工中起带头作用而被捕。他们最终在提供将来行为端正的担保后，分别于8月9日和14日获释。

8月5日，招商局（China Merchants S. N. Co.）所属四艘船舶的船员罢工，以强制要求将其工资提高至1922年3月南方港口海员罢工解决时香港通行的水平。其他几家小型中国航运公司也受到影响，但除三北轮埠公司（San Poh Steam Navigation Co.）外，其余公司均立即同意了海员的条件，其船只仅停航一两天。8月14日，三北轮埠公司与海员工会达成协议，从而使争议完全局限于海员工会与招商局之间。与此同时，该公司其他船只的船员在船只抵达上海后立即离船上岸，直至8月24日，该公司有二十四艘轮船停泊在江面闲置。罢工最终于8月25日解决，双方在公司办事处签署协议，工人获得了所要求的加薪，但同意加薪日期从5月1日起算，而非最初要求的1月1日。

8月7日，从星辉车行（Star Ricsha Company）租赁人力车的闸北车场分包商拒绝向约600名车夫出租车辆，但8月8日所有车辆均照常运营。公共人力车行业存在大量动荡，中国分包商指控星辉车行在维修、损失等方面收费过高。承包商代表与

the proprietor of the company and an amicable arrangement
will probably be reached.

At 6 a.m. August 9 a dispute arose between the
management and employees of the Da Kong Cotton Mill, 91A
Yangtsepoo Road. The mill is a newly established one,
is owned by Japanese, and there are about 800 female
and 400 male workers employed there. There has been
tension in the mill for some time owing to the management
insisting on the day workers cleaning up the rooms which
takes about 20 minutes each day after work stops at
5.30 p.m. Shortly before 6 a.m. on August 9 the
Japanese foremen accused some female workers on night
work of going to the lavatories to loaf, a quarrel
ensued and the day workers declined to start work at
6 a.m. The differences were afterwards settled and all
the employees resumed work at about 10 a.m. August 9.

公司业主之间的谈判正在进行中，可能会达成友好的安排。

8月9日上午6时，杨树浦路91A号的大康纱厂（Da Kong Cotton Mill）管理层与员工之间发生纠纷。该厂为新近设立，由日本人所有，雇佣约800名女工和400名男工。由于管理层坚持要求日班工人在下午5:30下班后每天花费约20分钟打扫车间，厂内紧张局势已持续一段时间。8月9日上午6时前不久，日本领班指责一些夜班女工去厕所偷懒，随即发生争吵，日班工人拒绝在上午6时开工。分歧随后得到解决，所有员工于8月9日上午10时左右复工。

5 Week ending Sept 4 1922

The Amalgamated Association of Street Unions, the
headquarters of which are at 145 Voong Kyih Lee(逢吉里),
Kweichow Road, are organizing a public meeting to officially
welcome Dr. Sun Yat Sen. They state that 60 local societies,
including labour societies, street unions and provincial
associations have promised to take part in the affair. The
A. A. of Street Unions will endeavour to hire the hall of the
International Institute, Frenchtown, or of the Chinese
General Chamber of Commerce, North Honan Road in which to
hold the meeting. It is not intended to hold a procession
or other formof outside demonstration but Dr. Sun will be
asked to speak and give the meeting an outline of his
future policy, concerning Chinese national affairs. The
date of the meeting have not been definitely settled but
Sept. 9 has been provisionally decided upon.

Neither the Authorities of the FrenchConcession
or the committee of the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce
have so far been consulted on the question of permitting
the meeting to welcome Dr. Sun Yat sen which the Amalgamated
Association of Street Unions are endeavouring to organize.
The French Police say that if an application is made to allow
the meeting to be held at the International Institute they
believe the application will be refused. Mr. Soong Man
Chang(宋漢章), President of the Chinese General Chamber
of Commerce and Manager of the Bank of China, 5 Hankow Road,
states that if an application is made to allow the meeting
to take place in the hall of the Chinese General Chamber
of Commerce, the application will be considered by the
committee of the Chamber but he is unable to say what line

5 截至1922年9月4日当周

马路商界联合会（Amalgamated Association of Street Unions），总部设在贵州路逢吉里145号，正在组织一次公众集会，以正式欢迎孙中山博士。他们声称，包括劳工社团、马路商会和省籍同乡会在内的60个本地团体已承诺参与此事。马路商界联合会将努力租用法租界万国协会或北河南路上海总商会的礼堂来举行会议。不打算举行游行或其他形式的外部示威，但将邀请孙中山博士发表演讲，并向会议概述其关于中国国家事务的未来政策。会议日期尚未最终确定，但暂定为9月9日。

法租界当局或上海总商会委员会均未就允许举行欢迎孙中山博士的集会一事进行咨询，该集会正由马路商界联合会努力组织。法国警方表示，如果申请在万国协会举行会议，他们认为申请将被拒绝。中国银行经理、上海总商会会长宋汉章（Soong Man Chang）先生（汉口路5号）表示，如果申请在上海总商会礼堂举行会议，商会委员会将对申请予以考虑，但他无法说明委员会可能采取何种立场。
