Soong would not state his personal views regarding the matter.
About twenty persons representing various local
labour and other organizations assembled at the headquar-
ters of the New A.A. of Street Unions, 145 Voong Kyih Lee,
Kweichow Road, at 5 p.m. August 30. It was decided to write
to the manager of the Sing Woo Dan(新舞臺) Theatre,
Cheu Meu Dien(九畝田), Chinese city asking him to let
the theatre to them for a public meeting to welcome Dr.
Sun Yat Sen, The meeting also announced that a joint
meeting of all organizations would be held at 2 p.m. Sept. 3
at the headquarters of the New A. A. of Street Unions
to make final arrangements for the meeting o f welcome.
About 80 organizations are taking part in the
preparations for the public meeting of welcome of Dr. Sun
Yat Sen. A notice has been sent to all local societies
saying that as there will be a large number of participants
in the chair and many more arrangements have to be made, a
big meeting is urgently necessary to discuss the financial
side of the affair and the place in which to hold the
meeting. At their fourth meeting held yesterday, the
preparatory committee unanimously decided to call a joint
meeting of representatives of all societies which have
joined the movement at 2 p.m. Sunday Sept. 3 at the
headquarters of the New A. A. of Street Unions, 145 Voong
Kyih Lee, Kweichow Road.
The meeting of representatives of various local
societies which it was proposed to hold at 145 Voong Kyih
Lee, Kweichow Road, at 2 p.m. on Sept. 3 and which was
prohibited by the Police on the grounds that it was of a
political nature and therefore contrary to Municipal
Regulations, did not take place. The meeting was for the
purpose of formulating plans and adjusting financial
matters in connection with the holding of a monster meeting
to extend a welcome to Dr. Sun Yat Sen, which is proposed

Shanghai Journal of Commerce
29-8-'22
Fang Tsung Wu 方振武 one of the commanders of the anti-Northern Expeditionary Force, arrived in Shanghai the day before yesterday and called upon Dr. Sun Yat Sen to whom he reported that after having been defeated by the northern army, his forces in Kiangsu retreated to Anhui and afterwards proceeded to Chekiang where they were disarmed and repatriated by Lu Yung Ziang who paid one month's salary to the subordinate officers and to the soldiers.
In response to his appeal for help, Sun Yat Sen directed him to stay in Shanghai pending further orders.

Shanghai Journal of Commerce
31-8-'22
Acting on instructions from Tuan Chi Jui and Chang Tso Ling, General Wu Kwong Sin 吴光新 arrived in Shanghai the other day and is now staying in the residence of Lu Yung Ziang at No. 16 Yates Road. He was entertained to dinner the night before last by Sun Yat Sen at the latter's residence in Rue Moliere, Frenchtown, at which many prominent Kuomintangs were present.
During the function General Wu declared that Tuan Chi Jui and Chang Tso Ling respect Sun Yat Sen to whom they will render assistance with a view to enabling him to attain his ideals.

Shanghai Journal of Commerce
2-9-'22
Three representatives of the Old A. A. of Street Unions at 1 p.m. yesterday called at the residence of Sun Yat Sen in Rue Moliere, where they were received by Sun himself. The representatives asked him to explain his attitude.
Sun stated that the citizens are all responsible for their country, especially at the present time when it is in danger. Shanghai is a commercial centre, wherein the merchants are very influential. For instance, their shops went on strike on May 4 (1 in 1920) resulting in the release of the declaration of a general strike is the last step which the merchants should take, and he was of opinion that the merchants should not take that step unless it was unavoidable. He hoped therefore, that all the merchants will do their duty as citizens.
The representatives, in reply, expressed the hope that Sun will not only work for the country but will also devise ways and means to help the merchants and labourers.
Sun replied that he would do his best for them. The conversation lasted about 45 minutes.

《上海商报》
1922年8月29日
反北伐军指挥官之一方振武于前日抵达上海，并拜谒孙中山博士。他向孙报告称，其部队在江苏被北军击败后，退至安徽，随后进入浙江，在那里被卢永祥解除武装并遣散；卢永祥向其下级军官和士兵发放了一个月的薪饷。
针对他的求助请求，孙中山指示他留在上海，等候进一步命令。

《上海商报》
1922年8月31日
奉段祺瑞和张作霖之命，吴光新将军日前抵达上海，现寓居亚尔培路（Yates Road）16号卢永祥宅邸。前晚，孙中山在其法租界莫利爱路（Rue Moliere）的寓所设宴款待吴将军，许多国民党要人出席了宴会。
席间，吴将军宣称，段祺瑞和张作霖尊重孙中山，并将向他提供援助，以助其实现理想。

《上海商报》
1922年9月2日
昨日午后一时，马路商界联合会三位代表前往孙中山位于莫利爱路的寓所拜访，由孙亲自接见。代表们请他阐明其立场。
孙中山表示，国民对国家均负有责任，尤其是在当前国家危亡之际。上海是商业中心，商人影响力巨大。例如，他们的店铺曾在5月4日（1920年？）罢工，导致发布总罢工宣言。他认为，总罢工是商人应采取的最后手段，除非万不得已，否则不应采取此步骤。因此，他希望所有商人都能履行作为公民的责任。
代表们回应表示，希望孙中山不仅为国家效力，还能想出办法帮助商人和劳工。
孙中山答复称，他将尽力为他们效劳。谈话持续了约45分钟。
马路商界联合会主席余化龍因身体不适，未出席。
